title: Apex Drift 3D
description: Nail razor-close hairpin drifts with one-thumb timing—hold to kick the tail out around tight corners and release to rocket down every straightaway.
controls: Press and hold before corners to initiate a drift, then release as you exit the apex to straighten out at full speed.

zh-CN.title: 巅峰漂移
zh-CN.description: 一指入弯极限漂移赛车：入弯长按甩尾贴着弯心拉出完美烟带，出弯松手全速弹射，手感丝滑到停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 入弯按住屏幕触发漂移过弯，出弯松手回正加速，连续完美过弯冲击最高连击。
